notes.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York is coming!
notes.content:
Greetings, Kindred!
 
The third installment of the New York Trilogy in the [b]Vampire: The Masquerade[/b] series is coming soon to Steam and consoles. [b]Even better, you can already play the demo during the Steam Next Fest![/b]
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658720
 
Immerse yourself in the gripping narrative and explore the intricate power dynamics of New York's vampire society. Don't miss your chance to get an early taste of the story and gameplay that awaits [b]you[/b]!
 
If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to share them with us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2658720/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url] 
 
[h3]Don't hesitate to add the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658720
]game[/url] to your wishlist if you like it![/h3]

notes.title: Version 1.01 is live! Brazilian-Portuguese language added
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you well![/h1]

It’s my great pleasure to inform you that the waiting is finally over and [b]you can now play Vampire: The Masquerade: Shadows of New York in Brazilian-Portuguese![/b]

Thank you so much for your patience and understanding! It has been a long process, but thanks to the hard work and skills of [b]Shadows’[/b] Brazilian-Portuguese team of translators and great effort made by our QA and implementation team, the update is now live!

Next to adding Brazilian-Portuguese (as well as French and Russian!) language to the game, the latest patch (version 1.0.10) also includes a few minor bug fixes.

For those of you, who already tasted the full Lasombra expierience, take a look at [b]Coteries of New York[/b] - our first [/b]Vampire: The Masquerade[/b] game, which lets you play a young, newly born vampire, representing one of three iconic Clans: Ventrue, Brujah or Toreador and learn what does it mean to live a Kindred's life on the streets of Big Apple! Go through the trailer and the game's description and if you like what you see, [b]buy Coteries of New York right now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096410/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York/

We encourage all of you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/QpJD8t9]official Discord server[/url], where you can talk directly with both [b]Coteries’[/b] and [b]Shadows’[/b] developers!

Thank you for your ongoing trust and continuous support!

Take care and stay healthy!

Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team

///

[h1]Olá queridos membros da #vamily! Esperamos que essa mensagem  encontre todos bem![/h1]

É com grande prazer que informo que a espera acabou e que vocês agora [b]podem jogar Vampiro: A Máscara: Shadows of New York em Português Brasileiro![/b] 

Muito obrigado pela paciência e compreensão! Foi um processo longo, mas graças ao trabalho duro e a perícia do nosso time de tradutores do [b]Shadows[/b] em português brasileiro e um grande esforço do nosso time de QA e implementação, a atualização no ar!

Junto com a adição das línguas Português Brasileiro (assim como Frances e Russo!) no jogo, o nosso mais recente patch (versão 1.0.10) também inclui algumas correções de pequenos bugs.

Para aqueles de vocês, que já experimentaram a experiência Lasombra completa, deem uma olhada no [b]Coteries de Nova York[/b] – nosso primeiro jogo de [b]Vampiro: A Máscara[/b], que te permite jogar com um jovem, recém-abraçado vampiro, representando um dos três Clãs icônicos: Ventrue, Brujah ou Toreador e aprenda o que significa viver  uma vida de Membro nas ruas da Big Apple! Dê uma olhada no trailer e na descrição do jogo e se gostar do que ver, compre [b]Coteries de Nova York[/b] agora mesmo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096410/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York/

Encorajamos vocês todos a entrar no nosso [url=https://discord.gg/QpJD8t9]server oficial do Discord[/url], onde podem falar diretamente com ambos os desenvolvedores do [b]Coteries[/b] e do [b]Shadows[/b]!

Obrigado pela confiança permanente e pelo suporte contínuo!

Se cuidem e fiquem bem!

Tudo de bom, 
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team

[h1]Salutations à vous chers membres de la #vamily! J'espère que ce message vous trouvera en bonne santé ![/h1]

C'est avec un très grand plaisir que je vous annonce que l'attente touche enfin à son terme et que [b]vous pouvez désormais jouer à Vampire: The Masquerade: Shadows of New York en français ![/b]

Merci infiniment de votre patience et de votre compréhension. Le processus a été long, mais grâce au dur travail et aux compétences du traducteur de [b]Shadows[/b], Benjamin, et aux superbes efforts réalisés par notre équipe Assistance Qualité et mise en œuvre, la mise à jour est maintenant disponible !

notes.title: Summer Sale Madness Is Upon Us!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear members of #vamily, I hope you're all healthy and well![/h1]

It's June 24th and this Summer, as every other year, our wallets will burn, our eyes will cry out and home budget planning skills will be put to a test! [b]It's time to start the Steam Summer Sale Madness![/b]

notes.title: Serial Cleaners – a glimpse of our upcoming game
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you in good health![/h1]

While part of our team is responsible for overseeing the progress the translators make with bringing new language versions to [b]Coteries[/b] and [b]Shadows[/b], the majority of the development team works on [b]Serial Cleaners – a single player, isometric stealth action game[/b] – a sequel to our game [b]Serial Cleaner[/b], which boasts more than 1,3 million owners on all platforms around the world!

[b]Serial Cleaners[/b] tell the story of four cleaners for the mob – shady figures, whose task is to clean after gangsters in New York city in the 90s. Each and every character has a personality and skill set of his own and while the complex story evolves, players will taste four distinct playstyles – from very tactical and stealthy to fast and ruthless. All of this in the delicious sauce of Jean Michel Basquiat’s-inspired art style and music from the era.

That said [b]we encourage you to take a look at an actual work-in-progress gameplay, recorded in-game, which dynamically shows the process of creating the map, as well as one of protagonists - Lati, moving around the level[/b], when the cops are arriving to the scene! [b]And the scene itself is one and only 5Pointz, one of the most iconic mural spaces in the world![/b] Check it out below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i4frMErq1Ds

notes.title: Wow, there will be a new Werewolf: The Apocalypse game!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear members of #vamily, I hope our announcement finds you in good health![/h1]

You learned everything about [b]Vampire: The Masquerade[/b] through our gameand other fully licensed [b]VtM products[/b], but [b]World of Darkness[/b] is much more than that. There are Mages, Wraiths... and Werewolves. Thanks to our buddies from [b]Different Tales[/b], soon you will be able to find out a lot more about the entire [b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse[/b] setting. 

Written by the people behind The Witcher 1 and 2, and the Wanderlust series, [b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest[/b] is going to be a pen-and-paper-like experience set in Europe's last primeval forest.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aQ7CulMwjHk

[b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Heart of the Forest[/b] takes place in modern times, in a real ancient wilderness called Puszcza Białowieska. You'll explore it as Maia, a young woman looking to uncover the truth about her family. 

During your adventure, you'll come upon many real myths and places surrounding the forest. You'll also find yourself in the middle of an ancient conflict between the protectors of Gaia and the forces that want to destroy her.

The special thing about [b]Heart of the Forest[/b] is that, much like [b]Coteries of New York[/b], the game itself is the Game Master. It tells you a story, and you decide how to deal with each situation considering your stats or inclination. We’ve always found this approach stylish and exciting. 

Follow & wishlist [b]Heart of the Forest[/b] and let us know what you think!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/]Follow Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest[/url]

Stay well and healthy!

Jace @ Draw Distance dev team

In [b]Shadows of New York[/b] you will play as a member of the [b]Lasombra[/b] clan and investigate the gruesome death of the New York's Anarch leader. Master the shadows and communicate with the inhabitants of the Other Side, but beware – Oblivion is always lurking out there, ready to devour you whole...

I hope you'll enjoy [b]Shadows of New York[/b] story when the game launches! As always we encourage you to share your feedback, as well as add [b]Shadows of New York[/b] to your wishlists!
